audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with Daniel beast imagery and imperial cult symbolism; draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for sea beast, land beast, image, mark, number 666. Anti-paranoia and anti-targeting safeguards required.

verses.restored: And I saw a beast rising from sea, having ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on horns and blasphemous names on heads.

familiar.text: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.

modern.text: Then I saw a beast with ten horns and seven heads rising out of the sea. There were ten royal crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.

original.text: Καὶ εἶδον ἐκ τῆς θαλάσσης θηρίον ἀναβαῖνον, ἔχον κέρατα δέκα καὶ κεφαλὰς ἑπτά, καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν κεράτων αὐτοῦ δέκα διαδήματα, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτοῦ ⸀ὀνόματα βλασφημίας.

verses.restored: The beast was like leopard, feet like bear, mouth like lion; dragon gave it power, throne, and great authority.

familiar.text: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.

modern.text: The beast I saw was like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.

original.text: καὶ τὸ θηρίον ὃ εἶδον ἦν ὅμοιον παρδάλει, καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὡς ἄρκου, καὶ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ ὡς στόμα λέοντος. καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ δράκων τὴν δύναμιν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξουσίαν μεγάλην.

verses.restored: One of its heads seemed slain into death, and its wound was healed; whole earth marveled after beast.

familiar.text: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.

modern.text: One of the heads of the beast appeared to be mortally wounded. But the mortal wound was healed, and the whole world marveled and followed the beast.

original.text: καὶ μίαν ἐκ τῶν κεφαλῶν αὐτοῦ ⸀ὡς ἐσφαγμένην εἰς θάνατον, καὶ ἡ πληγὴ τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ ἐθεραπεύθη. καὶ ⸀ἐθαυμάσθη ⸂ὅλη ἡ γῆ⸃ ὀπίσω τοῦ θηρίου,

verses.restored: They worshiped dragon because he gave authority to beast, and worshiped beast, saying: Who is like the beast, and who can war with it?

familiar.text: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?

modern.text: They worshiped the dragon who had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who can wage war against it?”

original.text: καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ δράκοντι ⸂ὅτι ἔδωκεν⸃ τὴν ἐξουσίαν τῷ θηρίῳ, καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ θηρίῳ λέγοντες· Τίς ὅμοιος τῷ θηρίῳ, καὶ τίς ⸀δύναται πολεμῆσαι μετʼ αὐτοῦ;

verses.restored: A mouth was given speaking great things and blasphemies, and authority to act forty-two months.

familiar.text: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.

modern.text: The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.

original.text: Καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ στόμα λαλοῦν μεγάλα καὶ ⸀βλασφημίας, καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ ⸀ἐξουσία ποιῆσαι μῆνας ⸀τεσσεράκοντα δύο.

verses.restored: It opened its mouth in blasphemy toward the Divine, to blaspheme his name, dwelling, and those dwelling in heaven.

familiar.text: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.

modern.text: And the beast opened its mouth to speak blasphemies against God and to slander His name and His tabernacle—those who dwell in heaven.

original.text: καὶ ἤνοιξε τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ εἰς ⸀βλασφημίας πρὸς τὸν θεόν, βλασφημῆσαι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ, τοὺς ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ σκηνοῦντας.

verses.restored: It was given to make war with holy ones and conquer them, and authority was given over every tribe, people, tongue, and nation.

familiar.text: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

modern.text: Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.

original.text: καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ ποιῆσαι πόλεμον μετὰ τῶν ἁγίων καὶ νικῆσαι αὐτούς, καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ ἐξουσία ἐπὶ πᾶσαν φυλὴν καὶ λαὸν καὶ γλῶσσαν καὶ ἔθνος.

verses.restored: All dwelling on earth will worship it, everyone whose name has not been written from foundation of world in scroll of life of the Lamb slain.

familiar.text: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

modern.text: And all who dwell on the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written from the foundation of the world in the Book of Life belonging to the Lamb who was slain.

original.text: καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν ⸀αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, ⸀οὗ οὐ γέγραπται τὸ ὄνομα ⸀αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τῆς ζωῆς τοῦ ἀρνίου τοῦ ἐσφαγμένου ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου.

familiar.text: If any man have an ear, let him hear.

modern.text: He who has an ear, let him hear:

verses.restored: If anyone is for captivity, into captivity one goes; if anyone kills by sword, by sword one must be killed. Here is endurance and trust of holy ones.

familiar.text: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.

modern.text: “If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he will go; if anyone is to die by the sword, by the sword he must be killed.” Here is a call for the perseverance and faith of the saints. The Beast from the Earth

original.text: εἴ τις ⸂εἰς αἰχμαλωσίαν, εἰς αἰχμαλωσίαν⸃ ὑπάγει· εἴ τις ἐν μαχαίρῃ ⸀ἀποκτανθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν μαχαίρῃ ἀποκτανθῆναι. ὧδέ ἐστιν ἡ ὑπομονὴ καὶ ἡ πίστις τῶν ἁγίων.

verses.restored: And I saw another beast rising from earth; it had two horns like lamb and spoke like dragon.

familiar.text: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.

modern.text: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. This beast had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.

original.text: Καὶ εἶδον ἄλλο θηρίον ἀναβαῖνον ἐκ τῆς γῆς, καὶ εἶχεν κέρατα δύο ὅμοια ἀρνίῳ, καὶ ἐλάλει ὡς δράκων.

verses.restored: It exercises all authority of first beast before it, and makes earth and those dwelling in it worship first beast whose death-wound was healed.

familiar.text: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.

modern.text: And this beast exercised all the authority of the first beast and caused the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose mortal wound had been healed.

original.text: καὶ τὴν ἐξουσίαν τοῦ πρώτου θηρίου πᾶσαν ποιεῖ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ. καὶ ⸀ποιεῖ τὴν γῆν καὶ τοὺς ἐν αὐτῇ κατοικοῦντας ἵνα ⸀προσκυνήσουσιν τὸ θηρίον τὸ πρῶτον, οὗ ἐθεραπεύθη ἡ πληγὴ τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: It does great signs, even making fire descend from heaven to earth before humans.

familiar.text: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,

modern.text: And the second beast performed great signs to cause even fire from heaven to come down to earth in the presence of the people.

original.text: καὶ ποιεῖ σημεῖα μεγάλα, ⸂ἵνα καὶ πῦρ ποιῇ⸃ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ⸂καταβαίνειν εἰς⸃ τὴν γῆν ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

verses.restored: It misleads earth-dwellers by signs given it to do before beast, telling them to make image to beast that had sword-wound and lived.

familiar.text: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.

modern.text: Because of the signs it was given to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived those who dwell on the earth, telling them to make an image to the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet had lived.

original.text: καὶ πλανᾷ ⸀τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς διὰ τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ ποιῆσαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θηρίου, λέγων τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ποιῆσαι εἰκόνα τῷ θηρίῳ, ⸂ὃς ἔχει⸃ τὴν πληγὴν ⸂τῆς μαχαίρης καὶ ἔζησεν⸃.

verses.restored: It was given to give breath to image of beast, so image might speak and cause those not worshiping image to be killed.

familiar.text: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.

modern.text: The second beast was permitted to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship it to be killed. The Mark of the Beast

original.text: καὶ ἐδόθη ⸀αὐτῷ ⸂δοῦναι πνεῦμα⸃ τῇ εἰκόνι τοῦ θηρίου, ἵνα καὶ λαλήσῃ ἡ εἰκὼν τοῦ θηρίου καὶ ποιήσῃ ⸀ἵνα ὅσοι ἐὰν μὴ προσκυνήσωσιν τῇ εἰκόνι τοῦ θηρίου ἀποκτανθῶσιν.

verses.restored: It makes all, small and great, rich and poor, free and enslaved, receive a mark on right hand or forehead,

familiar.text: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:

modern.text: And the second beast required all people small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,

original.text: καὶ ποιεῖ πάντας, τοὺς μικροὺς καὶ τοὺς μεγάλους, καὶ τοὺς πλουσίους καὶ τοὺς πτωχούς, καὶ τοὺς ἐλευθέρους καὶ τοὺς δούλους, ἵνα ⸀δῶσιν αὐτοῖς ⸀χάραγμα ἐπὶ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν τῆς δεξιᾶς ἢ ἐπὶ τὸ μέτωπον αὐτῶν,

verses.restored: so no one may buy or sell unless having the mark, the name of beast or number of its name.

familiar.text: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.

modern.text: so that no one could buy or sell unless he had the mark—the name of the beast or the number of its name.

original.text: καὶ ἵνα μή τις ⸀δύνηται ἀγοράσαι ἢ πωλῆσαι εἰ μὴ ὁ ἔχων τὸ χάραγμα, τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θηρίου ἢ τὸν ἀριθμὸν τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: Here is wisdom: the one having mind calculate number of beast, for it is number of human; its number is six hundred sixty-six.

familiar.text: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.

modern.text: Here is a call for wisdom: Let the one who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and that number is 666.

original.text: ὧδε ἡ σοφία ἐστίν· ὁ ἔχων νοῦν ψηφισάτω τὸν ἀριθμὸν τοῦ θηρίου, ἀριθμὸς γὰρ ἀνθρώπου ἐστίν· καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς ⸀αὐτοῦ ⸂ἑξακόσιοι ἑξήκοντα ἕξ⸃.

translation_notes: Beasts combine Daniel imagery and imperial power/cult symbolism; avoid mapping them onto modern persons or groups.
Mark of beast is allegiance/economic participation imagery, not random technology panic.
666 is apocalyptic gematria/empire-number needing second-pass audit.
safety_note: Revelation 13 must not fuel conspiracy targeting, antisemitism, anti-vaccine/technology panic, or violence. It critiques coercive empire, propaganda, worship, and economic allegiance.
